titulo: F5 (Apr 2023): $350 million stock buybacks, 623 roles being cut. Now the math.
caption:
From the archive: Apr 2023. Not today's news.
F5, Apr 19, 2023 (CEO letter, 8-K Exhibit 99.2): "I am deeply sorry for the impact this decision will have on you and your family"
In April 2023, F5 said it was reducing its team by 623 roles, 9% of its workforce, per its 8-K letter to employees. Its 10-K reports $350.0 million in stock buybacks in fiscal 2023.

Same fiscal year: $350 million stock buybacks, fiscal 2023, company-wide. $350.0 million of cash used to repurchase common stock in fiscal 2023, company-wide (MD&A of the 10-K); F5 pays no dividend.
The math: $350 million stock buybacks, fiscal 2023, company-wide ÷ 623 roles = $561,797 in stock buybacks for every job cut. The result is approximate.
The facts: $350 million stock buybacks, fiscal 2023, company-wide (F5 10-K, fiscal 2023, Nov 14, 2023). 623 roles being cut (F5 CEO letter, SEC 8-K, Apr 19, 2023). Both figures come from F5's own filings for fiscal 2023, which ended Sep 30, 2023. The cuts fell inside that fiscal year. The buybacks are the company's full-year total, not a figure tied to the cuts.

Deeply sorry. Here is the buyback column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: F5 CEO letter, SEC 8-K, Apr 19, 2023; F5 10-K, fiscal 2023, Nov 14, 2023.

Swipe: the sentence, the number, the math, our take.

Tap the link in bio.
